brief.zh: 业务团队需要一次有限切换、培训和支持交接。核对必需功能是否实际执行，保全切换后新增记录，明确各角色如何验收以及谁接手未解决项。
brief.en: A customer team needs a cutover decision, role-based training and a support owner. Required untested items block acceptance and new records need preservation.
